title: Mode choice — drive and walk
caption: Drive and walk use the frozen OD-specific logit outputs. Transit is Not modelled because verified service-day costs were not established; the omitted transit bar is not a prediction of zero transit demand. Person trips and person-weighted generalized minutes are shown separately. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
transformation: Sum saved person_trips by modeled mode; cost = sum(person_trips × generalized_min) / sum(person_trips). Exclude unmodelled transit from quantitative bars and mark explicitly.
